title: record_class.registered payload (v1)
description: Wire payload of `record_class.registered`. Publishes the three facts a downstream pack needs to decide whether it may index, export or delete something - data classification, search/export eligibility and hold applicability - without publishing the custodian or the disposition authority. No field in this payload carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a party or authority handle, a document or its bytes, message content, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13; Framework 0.8.1 section 11).
